pairs.registryProposal: Tests such as task_executor.rs:2560 return Ok when git is unavailable or the fixture repository cannot be built, so they report a pass having asserted nothing. No technique cleanly owns this per-test silent skip in a test harness with no skip verb; platform-quirk-absorption stops at the runner boundary. A rule requiring such a skip to be counted or to name its reason would close the gap.
